h: Shabbos Reveals the Unity That Completes the World

p: and the holy Throne was prepared
For the completeness of the world
was in the creation of man,
for this is the purpose of creation:
that there be man with free choice,
accept His Kingship, blessed be His Name;
the glory of His Kingship from them.
that the day of Shabbos came,
for at the end of the sixth day it is written
and behold, it was very good";
that is, that the day of Shabbos came,
and behold, it was very good"
about everything that is the opposite of good,
that this too will be very good.
And this is what it says,
"And the holy Throne was prepared for the King,"
and the earth My footstool, etc.,
and where is the place of My rest?"
(בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּשֶׁב, פד, ג)
may you find favor before Me
just as you have found favor before Me
That is, on the seventh day,
through there being a complete nation
who recognize the power of His Kingship,
who cast aside all their affairs
for His honor, blessed be His Name;
(שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה כג, כג, א)
a parable of a king, etc.,
from when You stood at the sea
and we said shirah before You
And this is according to what they said
"They are the ones who first crowned Me King at the sea
ה׳ יִמְלוֹךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד (שְׁמוֹת טו, יח)
when all Yisrael accept upon themselves
the yoke of His Kingship, blessed be His Name,
for then He has contentment in His world
does not sit on His Throne of Glory
until it is made in the secret of One,
רָזָא דַּה׳ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד וְכוּלֵּי
the secret of 'Hashem is One and His Name is One,' etc."
And this is what is written
"'Hashem is One' is the upper unification;
בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
And the matter is according to what they said
(תַּנְחוּמָא סוֹף פָּרָשַׁת תֵּצֵא, כִּי תֵצֵא יא)
(Tanchuma, end of Ki Seitzei, Ki Seitzei 11):
the seed of Amalek is in the world,
כִּי יָד עַל כֵּס יָהּ וְכוּלֵּי
'For a hand is upon the throne of Yah, etc.'"
for the Name Havayah is not pronounced.
Now this needs to be understood:
and the crown-tip on the Yud
the Vav to the six middos,
and the letter Hei to Malchus,
So why are the letters Yud-Hei of the Name
which are of a higher level,
"From the rising of the sun to its setting
גָּדוֹל שְׁמִי בַּגּוֹיִם וְגוֹמֵר (מַלְאָכִי א, יא)
My Name is great among the nations, etc." (Malachi 1:11)
that they call Him "God of gods."
That is, all the nations admit
is the Creator of the world
and He is exalted above all;
only, they say that He handed over, chas v'shalom,
the conduct of this world to the constellations,
there is no connection between the letters Yud-Hei,
for the conduct of this world.
there is no recognition of this,
how there is a complete unity
and connection of the letters Yud-Hei
of the Name Havayah not being pronounced
and only in the World to Come
the seed of Amalek is in the world,"
that is, there is not recognized and made explicit
the unity of the letters of Havayah;
that is, the unity is not recognized,
which is the Crown of Kingship."
which is a semblance of the World to Come,
there is in it a revelation
and the connection of the letters Yud-Hei with Vav-Hei.
And this is "the secret of Shabbos,
which is united in the secret of One, etc.";
"Just as in your heart there is only One";
the recognition of the unity "Hashem is One";
"so in our heart there is only One"
בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
(רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא פִּנְחָס, חֵלֶק ג רל, א)
"Keser Elyon which is the Crown of Kingship,"
which is with the letter Aleph,
And this is what it says in Sefer HaBahir:
אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים וְגוֹמֵר (תְּהִלִּים קיח, כב)
"'The stone that the builders despised, etc.' (Tehillim 118:22):
the stone that was despised by
the aspect of Kudsha Brich Hu,
and the letter Vav precedes the letter Hei.
is a semblance of the World to Come,
and there is in it a revelation of
"Keser Elyon which is the Crown of Kingship,"
that even the conduct of this world
is conducted in the aspect of "Hu,"
which is the attribute of Atika,
as is written in the holy Zohar
and this is the meaning of
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
as a semblance of the World to Come,
according to what he measures in his heart."
And this is what it says:
and the holy Throne was prepared

p: And afterward the holy Zohar says:
when the day was about to be sanctified,
their spirits were going forth, etc.,
as they also said in the Gemara
But as for what the holy Zohar says,
as one blemished in its making, etc.,"
that their not being created with bodies
was a blemish in the world.
it is explained, where it wrote:
Rather, the Tree of good and evil
aroused that Other Side of evil,
and it sought to grow strong, etc.;
כֵּיוָן דְּחָמָא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא כָּךְ וְכוּלֵּי
when Hakadosh Baruch Hu saw this, etc."
of good and evil came about,
and through the day being sanctified,
so that evil would spread no further,
as it wrote there at length.
And this is the meaning of
as one blemished in its making":
from the blemish of the corruption,
and even that side of the north
that remained lacking in the world, etc.;
That is, the beginning of the Torah
are the revelation of the primordial light.
By contrast, the order of creation
that the northern side is open,
and the northern side is not enclosed."
"And He said" is not stated with it,
for it is the hidden intellect,
And this is that the Ches indicates
that He is alive in the heights of the world
that He is hidden from all thought;
and because of this it begins with Beis,
And from the light being hidden,
the aspect of "He made darkness His concealment,"
for so is expounded about this
וְזֶהוּ מִצָּפוֹן תִּפָּתַח הָרָעָה (יִרְמְיָה א, יד)
And this is "From the north the evil shall open forth" (Yirmiyahu 1:14).
which You have hidden for those who fear You."
And as is written in the holy Zohar
and take from His hands? etc.
that it is written 'You have hidden,' etc.;
That is, there is hidden in it
And this is what it says (Bamidbar 18:23):
the blemish of the world, etc.;
That is, through words of Torah,
and the northern side is completed
"which You have hidden for those who fear You,"
and through it it was perfected, etc."
is the time of the revelation
of the light of Torah she'b'al peh,
which is from the primordial light
